findings.ac: Exactly one module declares either canonical set (invariant 1)
findings.text: The single-declaration test in BT169_CanonicalTaxonomy.test.js only scans for the job-function set (files containing both 'business_ops' and 'regulatory' in single quotes). No assertion covers CANONICAL_SECTORS, although the AC says either set. api/submit.js declares a SECTORS allowlist (the seven keys plus agri_and_food and water_and_nature) and api/enrich.js lists the sector keys in a prompt, so adding a second sector declaration would pass the suite. The job-function scan is also quote-style fragile.

findings.ac: workflow_dispatch dry_run:true performs no database writes
findings.text: The BT169_DryRun.test.js recording client returns empty rows for every select, so reconcileCompanyJobDelta (guarded by '&& !dryRun' in runAtsIngestionBatch) and runLifecycleGuard (guarded by '!dryRun' in run-job-ingestion.js) have nothing to update or archive even when run. Removing either guard leaves client.writes == [] and the test passing. The delta-archive path is the one the issue's Notes say archived live postings during the outage, and the test never exercises it. The select_companies_for_ingestion rpc is not recorded as a write either.

findings.ac: Verification: no assertion anywhere asserts a legacy job-function value
findings.text: src/pages/JobView.test.jsx still carries a legacy job_function: 'engineering' fixture and funcOpts { 'engineering': ... }. It is a UI fixture rather than an expect() on a mapper value, but nothing mechanical (such as a grep-based test) enforces the AC. BT164_StuttgartShootoutIngest.test.js (unchanged) uses legacy slugs only as inputs to the supersession map, which is legitimate.

findings.ac: Stress Cases: malformed adapter payload cannot throw through the normalization seam (invariant 5)
findings.text: Malformed payloads are tested only by calling buildJobRows directly with object, array or number job_function and sector values. No test feeds a malformed model or ATS payload through an adapter (GeminiFlashAdapter.extractFromHtml, which now calls CANONICAL_JOB_FUNCTIONS.includes(job.job_function), or the ATS adapters) into the seam. The unclassifiable-role case is likewise tested at row level, not through the batch upsert.
